trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read: proposition block. RECOMPUTED the dimension formula (2j+1)n!/((n/2+j+1)!(n/2-j)!) three independent ways for every (n, j) with n <= 10 -- against the Clebsch-Gordan multiplicity C(n, n/2-j) - C(n, n/2-j-1) and against the two-row SYT hook-length count -- and all three agree in every case, so the displayed formula and the 'vanishes otherwise' parity clause are correct as printed. Also checked the Lean sibling's pawLeiDim: its natural-number division (twice_j+1)/2 looks wrong beside the .md's j but is exactly the ceiling that compensates the floored n/2 in the half-integer case; verified 0 mismatches for n <= 14, so it is correct and should not be 'fixed'. Register: no trap construction of any of the ten kinds.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: No trap. Structural flag, not fixed: the tikzcd diagram composes 1 -> Lambda^2 V -> V^(x)n -> V_j, a single composite from the unit to V_j, which by Schur's lemma is zero for every j != 0 -- so as drawn it cannot depict a basis element of Hom(V_j, V^(x)n) except in the trivial case. See the returned anomaly list.
